questions.prompt: Which of these are parts of the human ear?
questions.fact: The anvil is one of three tiny bones in the middle ear. With the hammer and stirrup, they are the smallest bones in your body.

questions.prompt: Which of these are types of knot?
questions.fact: Spinnaker, keel and tiller are parts of a sailing boat, where knots like the bowline get used most.

questions.prompt: How long is Bohemian Rhapsody, in minutes?
questions.fact: Just under six minutes. The record company said it was far too long for radio.

questions.prompt: How tall is the Burj Khalifa, in metres?
questions.fact: 828 m, more than twice the height of the Empire State Building.

questions.prompt: Which artist is famous for paintings of soup cans?
questions.hint: He also made a famous print of Marilyn Monroe, repeated in bright colours.
questions.fact: Andy Warhol painted 32 Campbell's soup cans, one for every flavour on sale in 1962.

questions.prompt: Which spirit goes into a margarita?
questions.hint: It is made from the agave plant in Mexico.
questions.fact: A classic margarita is tequila, orange liqueur and lime, with salt on the rim.
